mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing the two accounts was most worthwhile: it showed that they disagree about creation itself, not merely the name given to harm.

leastWorthwhile.text: Applying the causal rule to the mixed world moved quickly to opposed sources; I would have liked more examination of that inference.

surprise.text: The comparison brought out how much the disagreement turns on a knowing maker's responsibility, rather than foreknowledge alone.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the final combination was the only offered action rather than a meaningful choice.

continue.text: I would continue: the chapter made the competing premises clear while leaving room to question them.
